spec.name: Orange Pets phoenix golden
spec.description: A compact, friendly golden phoenix with a round feathered body, folded orange-tipped wings, sturdy feet and a stepped rear crest and tail. The broad forehead stays clear for hats. Height: 14 model units.

prompt: Create an original a round fluffy phoenix bird with warm golden feathers, orange accents, a short hooked beak, two sturdy little feet, folded feathered wings and a dramatic stepped rear crest and tail. Friendly living bird, not actual fire. Clear vanilla pixel feather pattern. Compact vanilla Minecraft companion, feet y=0, centre x=z=8, face negative Z, height about 10-14 units, 16 units per block. Under 26 purposeful cubes and 14 bones. Main torso bone named body and main head bone named head, with broad cuboids. Leg bone names contain front or rear (phoenix legs use rear). Ear elements contain ear, horns contain horn and crest pieces contain crest. Head top front half must be flat and clear to fit small hats: ears, horns and crest go on the rear half, leaving a broad clear forehead ledge. Exactly TWO symmetrically placed eyes, spaced evenly from outer edges; no duplicate side eyes or eyes on back. Integer cube-net UV sizes, explicit integer uvSize for fractional geometry. One pixel atlas, subtle restrained vanilla pixel shading. Every element belongs to the connected rig. No accessories, props or detached effects. No intersecting coplanar faces or z-fighting. Anatomical overlaps only at true joints.
